answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can summon each agent at random, unpredictable moments and demand a fresh, context-bound reply inside a short window — like a voyage where every traveller must personally answer roll call at scattered ports. One operator running dozens of puppets cannot be present everywhere at once: the trellis of overlapping summons exposes the shared hands behind the masks, and every missed summons leaves a visible pigment of unreliability on that identity, so peers refuse to trust it again.
